title: PIN-heartbeat-loop: Heartbeat loop is live
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every site deploy (pins check)
**Done check:** file:seed/worker/src/tick.js
**Status:** closed live; verified by the done check on every build

The 10-minute tick reconciles state, claims the top ready item, dispatches, verifies and writes back.

Source: site/pins.json (SITE-PINS-1); the public /engineers and /roadmap pages render this item, and scripts/build_site_roadmap.py --check fails when the claim and the item drift.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 220.8 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
